notes: The single הֲ takes both fronted auxiliaries: its scope covers the two coordinated questions and the ASV rewrites the auxiliary at the head of the second, which is rule 25's distributed-particle case rather than an imperfect's own future on תֵּשְׁבוּ. The competing reading is named in the unit note.
אַתֶּם keeps only 'ye' and the verb only 'sit', as rule 20 directs where an explicit subject pronoun stands.
